status_initial: Choose a template folder to start.
header_subtitle: Build ready-to-print PDF dossiers starting from Word / Excel / PDF templates per department.
card01_subtitle: Tell the app where the Word / Excel / PDF templates are and where to save generated PDFs.
card02_subtitle: Fill in the person details. Fields with * are mandatory.
card03_subtitle: Pick the department → see the document list → generate the PDF.
lbl_department_hint: Selection updates the list below in real-time.
help_tip_body:
Each template name drives department and copy count.
Format:  DEPARTMENT_NUMBER_CODE.doc/.docx  (or .xls/.xlsx / .pdf)
Example:  SAFETY_2_SIC.docx   (2 copies per employee)
secure_label: 🔒  Everything stays on this computer · no data sent over the network
mb_missing_name: Please provide first and last name.
mb_missing_dept: Please select at least one department.
mb_no_docs_body: There are no (selected) templates for the chosen department(s).
tt_name: Full name of the new hire (e.g. John Smith).
tt_date: Company entry date in DD/MM/YYYY format.
tt_role: Job title or role (e.g. "Production operator line 3").
tt_notes: Free-form notes visible in the dossier (e.g. "Introduce to H&S manager on day 1").
tt_dept: Affiliation department: matching templates + ALL templates will be included.
tt_multidept: Tick to combine templates from multiple departments.
tt_autoopen: When finished, auto-open the output folder in File Explorer.
tt_choose_tpl: Pick the local folder holding your Word/Excel/PDF template files.
tt_choose_out: Pick where to save the generated PDF dossiers.
tt_refresh: Re-scan all templates from the folder and refresh the list.
tt_depts: Add, rename or delete departments (updates reparti.txt).
tt_generate: Fills placeholders, merges everything into one PDF and saves it to the destination.
tt_batch: Import employee list from CSV/Excel and generate multiple PDFs at once.
tt_include: Uncheck to temporarily skip this template without removing the file.
bat_subtitle: Select CSV or Excel with columns Name, Date, Department (opt. Role, Notes).
bat_cols: Expected columns: Name · Date · Department [· Role · Notes]
de_hint: Custom departments are saved to reparti.txt together with those inferred from templates.
